Key observations:

- Upper leaves still green but plant looks distressed
- Progressive wilting pattern from bottom up
- Multiple plants/suckers from same base

This pattern strongly suggests Panama Disease (Fusarium wilt - wilting from bottom up). Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The Panama Disease reference image shows characteristic yellowing and browning of leaves consistent with Fusarium wilt. 

Comparing to the test image:
- **Test image**: Whole plant showing progressive wilting/death from lower leaves up, with brown dried lower leaves and still-green upper leaves — classic bottom-up wilt pattern
- **Panama Disease**: Causes wilting and death starting from lower leaves, progressing upward as the vascular system is compromised by Fusarium

This is distinctly different from Bunchy Top or BBTV, which would show stunted, erect leaves clustered at the top with marginal chlorosis — not extensive lower leaf die-back. The test image shows a plant in advanced Panama Disease decline.
